# Subway Seat for Hyper

Colors, cursor, selection, borders and the tab strip. Hyper 3 loads local plugins from `~/.hyper_plugins/local/` (`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hyper/.hyper_plugins/local/` when that's set, `%APPDATA%\Hyper\.hyper_plugins\local\` on Windows). The Hyper 4 canary reads `hyper.json` and `~/.config/Hyper/plugins/local/`. Hyper doesn't follow the system light/dark setting, so pick one flavor.

[Hyper](https://hyper.is) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/hyper/)

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only hyper
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['subway-seat'],
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['subway-seat-tunnel'],
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['subway-seat-enamel'],
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['london-moquette'],
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['london-deep-level'],
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['london-portland'],
```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['paris-guimard'],
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['paris-catacombes'],
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.hyper.js:

```typescript
localPlugins: ['paris-carrelage'],
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat-tunnel/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/subway-seat-enamel/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/london-moquette/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/london-deep-level/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/london-portland/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/paris-guimard/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/paris-catacombes/index.js`.
- Delete `~/.hyper_plugins/local/paris-carrelage/index.js`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
